I have successfully added the smooth scrolling feature to **all pages** (including Contact, Gallery, Attractions, About, and Index). 

Here is what I did:
1. **Global CSS Update:** I updated the main `index.css` file to force `scroll-behavior: smooth` across the entire website.
2. **HTML Class Updates:** I ran a script to ensure every single HTML file (`index.html`, `about.html`, `contact.html`, `gallery.html`, `attractions.html`, etc.) uses the Tailwind `scroll-smooth` class on the root element.

Now, whenever you click a link that points to a specific section on the same page (like "Home" or "Explore"), the browser will glide down the page smoothly instead of instantly jumping!

**To see the changes:**
Please fully refresh your browser (`Ctrl + F5`) on any page to load the new CSS rules.

I have fixed the issue! 

Previously, the code for the "Coming Soon" section was hardcoded to only show solid-color gradients with generic icons, regardless of what data was in `park-data.js`. 

I have updated the logic in `explorer.js` to:
1. Detect if you have provided an image URL in your `park-data.js` for upcoming attractions.
2. Display your new images as the background for those cards (with a nice hover zoom effect).
3. Fall back to the original gradients and icons *only* if no image is provided.
4. Added a subtle dark overlay over the images so the "Coming Soon" badge and texts remain highly visible.

Please refresh your `attractions.html` page (`Ctrl + F5`), and you will now see your Zipline and Indoor Roller Coaster images proudly displayed!
